newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt sells over 8,500 T cotton so far - exporters.
newsitem.headline: Egypt sells over 8,500 T cotton so far - exporters.

text.p: Egyptian exporters said on Monday they had sold 26,140 bales (8,535 tonnes) of cotton to international buyers two weeks into the export season.
The firms began selling their cotton on September 14, and Egypt expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of this year's harvest.

The Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa), which coordinates pricing and exports by 11 state-owned firms and seven private ones, said 16 countries had bought cotton, with Japan and the U.S. topping the list.
"So far we have sold a total of 11,988 bales of extra-long staple varieties and 14,152 of long staple. It's going well," an Alcotexa official told Reuters.
The association said it had run out of Giza 45 cotton for export but all other eight varieties were available.
Prices for these eight varieties were unchanged for the second week running, it said.
